title: Prove sharp P104 common-metric defect constant 37 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite premises and a sharp equality certificate. A common real ambient deformation of any two-disjoint-frame puncture of E8 satisfies the new quantitative identity

```text
A0 = A - tr(A) I/8
E_P(A) = 37 ||A0||_F^2
         + (17/2) sum of squared deleted-frame diagonals
         + sum of squared orthogonal cross-frame defects.
```

Here A is symmetric and E_P sums squared absolute inner products over unordered orthogonal unit-root pairs of the 104 remaining lines. Therefore E_P(A) >= 37 ||A0||_F^2. An explicit rational symmetric involution has norm squared 8 and energy 296. Rational invertible common maps I+sA attain equality arbitrarily near identity, proving 37 sharp even for positive definite metrics from rational maps.

For M=T^T T this bounds distance from a conformal metric by sqrt(E_P(M)/37). Exact qualitative rigidity is prior work; the contribution is the quantitative sum-of-squares identity and sharpness family. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed. Six files are added under `research/p104-metric-energy/`.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Brett Halligan / #1212, Aaron Wang / #1292, Josie Elliston / #1389 and #1399, and their retained E8 decoder lineage for the prior exact-realization questions and qualitative results. Standard E8 root coordinates and elementary frame facts retain their mathematical credit. No predecessor executable or proof is replayed as the deliverable.

## Evidence

- Before: qualitative exact-rigidity results supply context, without being re-audited here. After: the new identity gives an explicit defect bound and an attaining family.
- Exact integer checks enumerate all 120 root lines, 3,780 full orthogonal pairs and all 120 tight stars. Every quadratic identity is checked on all 1,296 coefficients. The equality example enumerates 2,860 orthogonal pairs and has energy 296. Seven controls distinguish missing data, invalid frame boundaries, a changed witness and a stronger proposed constant.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct runs and both registered commands pass on CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Initial timed direct commands each took 0.13 seconds, below the registered 60-second limits.
- Committed bytes and declared source ancestry pass at `5badad3af2ff7f6c325f20813a6176cc7e3111c0`. The official export and input-coverage check pass. Normal and optimized read-only Git-free replays with empty PATH agree; all seven exported files retain their hashes.

Exact reproduction from the worktree root, using the local interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-metric-energy/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-metric-energy/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-metric-energy --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the absolute path. The direct checker prints `PASS_P104_METRIC_ENERGY` and a generated receipt bound to all six source files.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The written frame-removal argument supplies the quantifiers over every pair of disjoint frames and every real symmetric matrix; the checker supplies exact finite E8 premises and the explicit equality example. This is a common-metric result using absolute inner products before separate normalization. Independent port motions, arbitrary masked fitting factors, normalized correlation optimization and complex Hermitian deformations are outside its scope. The sharp example is not identified with the selected P104 frame-pair orbit.

No native implementation, dirty restoration, complete signed invoice, selected supplier replay, all-size compiler, precision/tape proof, complete multiplier, Lean or Docker run is supplied. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The card's change to this geometry boundary question is explicit in TASK.json.

## Open next questions

- Determine the sharp constant for each individual disjoint-frame orbit, especially the selected P104 orbit. First compute the kernel of the residual squares for a fixed representative.
- Test independent port motions outside the common-metric class. First give one arbitrary-input local identity with restored outputs, an actual consumer and its complete paid/productive bill.
